body.condition: For every \(t\in\mathcal T\), \(a\in\mathcal A\), and \(v\in\mathcal V\), \(\mathbf 1\{J_t^a=v\}=\widetilde g_{tav}(S)\) almost surely.

novel.justification: The response map records first infection while permitting the period-two controlled response to depend on the identity of a prior noninfecting exposure. It retains arbitrary dependence among exposure histories and controlled susceptibilities and does not impose no priming.
